name: 二阶阻尼振子跨域 ζ 散度 REJECT
description: Second-order damped oscillator 类 v0.4 跨域验证 5 域(mechanical buildings n=20, RLC simulated n=24, pendulum n=24, FRED economic n=23, power-grid swing n=24)。Cross-domain ζ medians: pendulum 0.00056, mechanical building 0.012, RLC 0.076, economic 0.80, power grid 1.34。Max/min spread = 2395x,> 一阶段量级阈值 10x。Dominant regimes: pendulum & mechanical & RLC underdamped, economic near-critical, power grid overdamped——三种不同 damping regime。Verdict: REJECT,二阶 ODE 是 mathematical framework / descriptor 不是 universality class。

name: Tamura building damping 集中带 ζ ∈ [0.007, 0.016]
description: Tamura 数据库及 Architectural Institute of Japan 2012 / Kareem 1981 / Tamura-Suganuma 1996 / Li-Wu-Kareem 2013 综合 20 座超高层建筑(Burj Khalifa, Taipei 101, Shanghai WFC, Shanghai Tower, Sky Tree 等)第一振型 (ω₀, ζ)。Median ζ=0.012, range [0.007, 0.016]、ω₀ median 0.168 Hz, range [0.10, 0.22]。规律: 建筑高度 300-830 m 对应 ω₀ 0.10-0.22 Hz, ζ 集中在百分之一量级,符合 ASCE 7-22 设计值。在自己 domain 内 highly clustered,但单 domain clustering 不证明 universality(需跨域。)

name: Economic AR(2) cycle ζ 集中在 0.5-1.0 near-critical
description: FRED 10 系列(GDPC1, INDPRO, UNRATE, PCEC96, GDPDEF, PAYEMS, HOUST, CPILFESL, M2SL, DGS10) HP-filtered cycle + AR(2) OLS + rolling 60-obs windows step 10。AR(2) 复数根 → (ω, ζ) 转换。Cross-series median ζ=0.80, range [0.52, 0.99]。所有可识别周期都集中在 near-critical / heavily damped regime; ω₀ median 0.25 cycles/year (周期约 4 年, 对应商业循环)。与机械工程系统(ζ~0.01)差距 65x; 与单摆(ζ~0.0006)差距 1400x。证明宏观经济周期阻尼远强于物理振子,not the same universality class。

name: Power-grid swing equation ζ 跨设计选择
description: Kundur 1994 SMIB swing equation 24 simulated generators with H ∈ [2, 10] s, D ∈ [0.01, 5] pu, K_s ∈ [0.5, 3] pu。Cross-sample median ζ=1.34, range [0.022, 12.2] — spans underdamped to deeply overdamped。Reason: D 是工程设计选择(PSS controller/governor 决定),不同电厂从 weakly damped 到 critically damped。单 domain 内部 ζ 散度就 ~550x,根本无法和 mechanical building ζ~0.01 共同 cluster。Power-grid 'oscillation mode' 是 engineering parametric family 不是 mechanism class。

name: 二阶 ODE = mathematical framework, demote to Layer-0
description: Pre-class plan 预期 'likely SPLIT outcome',实测结果证实 REJECT。建议 paper positioning: 将 `second_order_damped_oscillator` 从 universality class 降级为 Layer-0 mathematical descriptor,与 `markov_chain_memory_fidelity`、`tail_copula_contagion`、`extreme_value_tail_class` 归入同一类——descriptor family 而非 mechanism class。KB 仍可保留 (ω₀, ζ) 作 common parameterisation,但不提 cross-domain scaling-law universality 主张。同时给出 demotion 的可复现判据: max/min(median ζ) > 10x AND domains span ≥ 2 regimes。

name: Pendulum ζ < 0.01 textbook 高 Q 普适
description: 24 simulated pendula 覆盖 Foucault demos (Pantheon 67m, Smithsonian 21m, MSU 17m, UN NY 13m, Griffith LA 12m), grandfather/seconds/Kater/Huygens clocks, ship-roll pendulums, ballistic & crane loads, lab torsion balances。Median ζ=0.00056 (Q≈900), range [5e-7, 0.21] — long Foucault pendula 极低 ζ ~ 1e-5,大型负载摆动(crane/ship)ζ ~ 0.01-0.2。在 underdamped regime 但跨度 5 个量级,与 RLC 类似的 'engineer 通过选材调阻尼' 特征,*在 domain 内部* 都不是单峰 cluster。

name: RLC 工程电路 ζ 跨设计跨越 6 量级
description: 24 simulated RLC presets covering audio LC tanks (ζ~5e-4), IF/crystal high-Q tanks (ζ~5e-5), filter low-pass medium-Q (ζ~0.1), PSU smoothing critically damped (ζ~0.5-1.5), snubber heavily overdamped (ζ~30)。Median ζ=0.076 但 range 跨 5e-5 到 33, 即 6+ 量级。说明 RLC 的 ζ 完全由工程师按用途选,不是 'class universal' 而是 'design space'。这与 mechanical buildings 的窄 cluster (因为建筑被动阻尼几乎只能取决于材料、约 0.5-2% range) 形成尖锐对比——同一 ODE 框架下行为完全相反。

name: Universality 判别 PASS gate: ζ spread + regime consistency
description: 本验证引入 pre-registered PASS gate 作为 'mechanism class vs mathematical descriptor' 的可复现判据: (1) 每个 domain N ≥ 20; (2) cross-domain max/min(median ζ) < 10; (3) 所有 domain dominant_regime 同一个(under/critical/over)。任何一项不达标 → REJECT for universality。本判据可推广到其他 candidate universality classes(尤其是 RD steady-state, Markov memory, EVT tail 等已 reject 的 descriptor 家族)的统一 demotion criterion。比传统 'cluster vs scatter' 判断更操作化、更可量化。
